T0571.title: Training Data Poisoning
T0571.definition: Manipulation of training, feedback, or labeling data to influence model behavior.
T0571.description: Training data poisoning manipulates training, feedback, or labeling data to alter model behavior, potentially causing backdoors, bias, misclassification, or safety-policy bypass. Controls focus on data-source trust, anomalous sample detection, labeling-process audits, training-version traceability, and adversarial testing before release.
T0571.usageExample: Assess Training Data Poisoning related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
